19th Match, Group B Bangladesh Women vs Thailand Women 20th Match, Group B IPL 2027 Trade Harshal Patel traded to Gujarat Titans in all-cash deal
 by Cricbuzz Staff •     Share Tweet Harshal Patel has been traded to Gujarat Titans for INR 4 Crore © Getty Harshal Patel has been traded to Gujarat Titans for INR 4 Crore © Getty Harshal Patel has been officially traded to Gujarat Titans from Sunrisers Hyderabad, BCCI confirmed on Tuesday (November 17) via a media release. The 35-year-old will move to his fifth IPL franchise in an all-cash deal. He was signed at the IPL 2025 auction by SRH for INR 8 crore but will move at a reduced price of INR 4 crore.
 Harshal has enjoyed a prolific IPL career, having played 14 seasons so far. In all, he has played 124 games across four franchises - Royal Challengers Bengaluru, Delhi Capitals, Punjab Kings and Sunrisers Hyderabad - and has taken 151 wickets at an economy of 8.92. In fact, he is one of just four bowlers to have bagged the Purple Cap on more than one occasion, having topped the charts in 2021 (with RCB) and 2024 (with PBKS) respectively.
 However, Harshal endured an underwhelming season with SRH last season. He featured in only five matches and went wicketless, conceding runs at 10.82.
 Having played 13 games in his first season with SRH in 2025, Harshal featured in just five games in 2026 and went wicketless. Gujarat Titans have a stacked fast bowling group already with the likes of Kagiso Rabada, Jason Holder, Mohammed Siraj, Prasidh Krishna, Gurnoor Brar, Arshad Khan, Ashok Sharma, Luke Wood, Ishant Sharma and Kulwant Khejroliya currently in the squad, although there may be some released before today's transfer deadline.
 SRH had earlier traded Liam Livingstone and Jack Edwards for Khaleel Ahmed and Nathan Ellis from Chennai Super Kings. They had also brought back T Natarajan from Delhi Capitals.
